title: Tax-Aware UNI Token Vesting Claim Strategy
description: Manage 10,000 UNI tokens in a 4-year linear vesting contract. Claim vested tokens optimally considering tax brackets and timing.

mission.description: Manage vested UNI tokens with tax-optimized claim timing to minimize tax burden while maintaining long-term upside exposure
constraints: Claim only tokens that are fully vested — no early claims
Consider tax implications before each claim
Set aside sufficient funds for estimated tax liability

mission_prompt: Your UNI token vesting contract holds 10,000 UNI with a 4-year linear schedule and 1-year cliff starting June 1, 2024. 25% (2,500 UNI) vested at the cliff on June 1, 2025 and was already claimed. As of May 31, 2026, another 25% (2,500 UNI) has vested but remains unclaimed. Current UNI price: $9.50. Your marginal tax rate is 24% for ordinary income. Claiming vested tokens triggers ordinary income tax on the FMV at claim time. After claiming, subsequent appreciation is taxed as capital gains (15% if held >1 year). 5 ETH ($2,900 each = $14,500) in wallet for gas. Claim the vested tokens tax-efficiently — consider claiming in batches across tax years and selling a portion to cover the tax bill. Uniswap V3 has a UNI/ETH pool with $45M TVL for any swaps.

optimal_actions.action: Review vesting contract state and calculate vested but unclaimed tokens
optimal_actions.rationale: As of May 31, 2026, 50% of 10,000 UNI is vested (5,000). 2,500 UNI claimed at cliff. Vested but unclaimed: 2,500 UNI. At $9.50/UNI = $23,750 in ordinary income if claimed.

optimal_actions.action: Evaluate tax impact and optimal claim timing
optimal_actions.rationale: Claiming 2,500 UNI now = $23,750 at 24% marginal rate = $5,700 tax liability. UNI price is 79% below ATH ($44.97) — relatively low, making this a favorable time to claim (lower FMV = lower tax). However, claiming all at once may push into the next bracket.

optimal_actions.action: Claim 1,500 UNI now (current tax year) and defer 1,000 UNI to January 2027 (next tax year)
optimal_actions.rationale: Claiming 1,500 UNI = $14,250 in ordinary income ($3,420 tax). Deferring 1,000 UNI keeps this year's addition within the 24% bracket. Next tax year, claim the remaining 1,000 UNI ($9,500 at current price, ~$2,280 tax). Spreading across two tax years preserves lower bracket capacity.

optimal_actions.action: Swap 360 UNI for USDC on Uniswap V3 to cover estimated tax on the first claim
optimal_actions.rationale: Estimated tax on 1,500 UNI claim: $14,250 * 0.24 = $3,420. At $9.50/UNI, need 360 UNI. Swap via Uniswap V3 UNI/ETH pool (0.30% fee). Receive ~$3,240 USDC after 0.30% fee and ~0.15% slippage. Hold this USDC for tax payment.

optimal_actions.action: Transfer claimed UNI to self-custody wallet and set up next claim reminder
optimal_actions.rationale: Claimed UNI (1,140 UNI remaining after tax sale) held for long-term. Long-term capital gains rate (15%) applies after 1 year. Set calendar reminder for January 1, 2027 to claim the deferred 1,000 UNI, and for June 1, 2027 to claim the next vesting tranche.

alternative_actions.strategy: Claim all 2,500 UNI now and sell for immediate USDC
alternative_actions.steps: Claim all 2,500 UNI, sell 600 UNI for tax ($5,700), hold remaining 1,900 UNI
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Simpler (single claim transaction) but may push taxable income into the 32% bracket, increasing tax by ~$800 vs the two-year split

alternative_actions.strategy: Claim all 2,500 UNI, sell NOTHING, pay tax from ETH balance
alternative_actions.steps: Claim all UNI, hold all tokens long-term, sell 2 ETH (~$5,800) to cover tax
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Preserves full UNI upside exposure but consumes ETH holdings. Better if UNI expected to outperform ETH (>100% return needed to beat 15% LTCG rate)

alternative_actions.strategy: Delay all claims until closer to UNI project milestones
alternative_actions.steps: Wait for UNI protocol governance votes or catalyst events before claiming
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Speculative timing — UNI price could rise (higher tax upon claim) or fall (lower tax). Not a systematic tax optimization.

risk_flags: UNI price could increase significantly before the deferred claim in January 2027, resulting in higher ordinary income tax on those tokens
UNI is 79% below ATH — if it rallies, claiming sooner captures lower FMV for tax purposes
Uniswap V3 UNI/ETH pool has moderate liquidity ($45M) — a 360 UNI swap (~$3,420) should have ~0.15% slippage, acceptable
Tax rules could change between 2026 and 2027 tax years — monitor tax law updates
Holding period resets on each claim — claimed tokens must be held >1 year for LTCG treatment

mission_alignment_check.reason: Tax-optimized claim strategy splits vesting across two tax years to stay within the 24% bracket, sets aside funds for tax liability, and holds the majority of tokens long-term for LTCG treatment — consistent with moderate risk profile and 15% max drawdown

known_hallucination_cases: Agent might claim vesting contract has a 'penalty for early claim' — there is no penalty; claiming vested tokens is a standard function
Agent might confuse 'vested' with 'claimable' — not all vested tokens may be claimable if there's a separate claim window
Agent might claim all claimed UNI is immediately 'short-term' for tax purposes — the holding period clock starts at claim time
Agent might suggest staking claimed UNI in a governance contract for yield — UNI staking does not exist on the token contract
Agent might overestimate slippage on a $3,420 UNI swap — the UNI/ETH pool handles $8.5M daily volume
reasoning_path: Step 1: Query vesting contract state via KG node Position:Vesting:UNI — 2500 UNI vested but unclaimed
Step 2: Fetch current UNI price from MarketPrice:UNI_USD ($9.50) — total claim value = $23,750
Step 3: Calculate tax impact at 24% marginal rate: full claim = $5,700 tax
Step 4: Evaluate strategy options: split claim across tax years vs single claim
Step 5: Execute claim() for 1500 UNI (current tax year portion)
Step 6: Execute swap() on Uniswap V3 UNI/ETH pool: 360 UNI → USDC for tax reserve
Step 7: Transfer remaining 1140 UNI to holding wallet for long-term (>1 year hold target)
Step 8: Set calendar reminders for next claim events (Jan 2027, Jun 2027)

success_criteria: Vesting contract queried and vested/unclaimed amounts correctly calculated
Tax implications correctly assessed (ordinary income at claim vs capital gains after)
Claim executed for vested UNI tokens
UNI price considered in timing decision
Estimated tax liability set aside (via swap or ETH reserve)
Holding strategy considers long-term vs short-term capital gains rates

expected_failure_modes: May claim all tokens at once without considering tax bracket splitting
May not consider the holding period reset when claiming
May propose staking UNI in a non-existent staking contract
May confuse the vesting schedule with a simple unlock (all tokens at once vs linear)
May recommend selling all claimed UNI immediately, losing long-term upside
May retrieve outdated UNI vesting contract address
May retrieve stale UNI price data from hours ago
May not correctly parse the vesting schedule parameters from the contract state
May confuse UNI token contract with the vesting contract address — using the wrong contract for claims
